title: Requirement
description: A binding, verifiable condition that the subject of the Why must satisfy.

id.description: Permanent, unique identifier. IDs must never be reused.

name.description: Short, descriptive name of the requirement.

area.description: A category defined by the repository for grouping related requirements.

description.description: A single condition describing required behavior or properties.
examples: Every page must be reachable using a keyboard.

rationale.description: One sentence in plain language explaining why this condition matters.
examples: People who navigate with a keyboard need access to every page.

decisions.description: Decisions that shaped this requirement. Omit the property when no significant choice stands behind the requirement.

obsolete.description: Marks a requirement as historical and no longer binding. Omit this property for active requirements.

test_exemption.description: Why no automated test cites this requirement, including the verification mechanism when one exists.
